'''Echo Nine''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Echo Flight]], a [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>

During the [[Battle at TFP-9]], [[Evenyl Yob]] thought that her [[Tactical computer/Legends|Tactical computer]] malfunctioned showed [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Headhunters]] out of nowhere. Nine told her that it was not a malfunction, but fresh real fighters that entered the battle.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap" />
